name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 3 - Am 53
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 3a. Calls for the EU and its Member States to prioritise diplomatic and political efforts aimed at achieving a sustainable end to the conflict in Ukraine and preventing its further prolongation, stressing that the primary objective of EU policy should be the restoration of peace and stability on the European continent; underlines that any security guarantees or defence commitments in relation to Ukraine remain a sovereign decision and competence of individual Member States; notes that increased security and defence cooperation between Ukraine, the EU and its Member States has required substantial financial resources from Member States and European taxpayers;
